topic: Identification / removal and installation of various system components.
syllabus_extract: Identification / removal and installation of various system components.
specific_objectives: 21.1.10.1 Trainee will be able to explain how to carry out DI / DR on aircraft system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification and removal/installation of system components; Safety: PPE, ESD protection, Torque limits; Supervision: Instructor monitors torque and alignment.
intro_questions: What does DI stand for in aircraft maintenance?
What does DR stand for in aircraft maintenance?
Why is component identification critical before removal?

topics: Definition of DI and DR procedures
development.content:
Definition of DI and DR procedures
Pre-requisites for component removal
Tools required for identification
Marking and tagging protocols
Documentation requirements

Step-by-step removal procedure
Installation alignment techniques
Torque application standards
Verification of installation
Post-installation inspection

Common errors in DI/DR
Troubleshooting installation issues
Safety checks during removal
Handling damaged components
Record keeping best practices

summary_questions: Explain the difference between DI and DR in your own words.
List three safety precautions required during component removal.
Describe the correct sequence for installing a system component.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the wire locking techniques discussed in LP 17 and how they relate to securing system components after installation.

pft_rows.syllabus: Practical on different wire locking techniques used during maintenance.
